verdict.rationale: Cactus is an LLM inference engine. Even though it targets on-device use, inference-serving optimizations are a fair axis for this kind of product, so the story applies. The evidence pack never mentions prefill/decode disaggregation or any large-scale serving architecture. It describes local CPU inference on phones, wearables and Raspberry Pis with 'no server', plus cloud routing based on confidence, which is a different feature.
